title: Procedural Cityscape with Smooth Vertex Normals
description: A small procedurally-generated city built from boxes, cylinders and spheres, with per-vertex normals fed through to the renderer's smooth-shaded technique pair. SAO, directional shadows and hemispherical IBL make the difference between flat and smooth shading easy to see — the dome and tower silhouettes round off across each ring of triangles instead of faceting.
